map.精子浓度参考器（WHO 第5版）：输入改良 Neubauer 计数板计数结果、计: Sperm Concentration Reference (WHO 5th edition): enter the counting result from an improved Neubauer chamber, the number of large squares counted, and the dilution factor to get the sperm concentration (×10⁶/mL) and compare it with the WHO 5th edition reference lower bound of 15×10⁶/mL.
Concentration (×10⁶/mL) = (counted sperm / large squares counted) × dilution factor × 0.01
map.C 为计数格内精子数、n 为格数、D 稀释倍数；×0.01 为板常数换算。: C is the sperm count in the counted squares, n the number of squares, D the dilution factor; the ×0.01 is the chamber constant conversion.
map.计数 0 需离心沉渣复检，仍无则报无精子症并进一步区分。: A count of 0 requires a centrifuged pellet recheck; if still none, report azoospermia and differentiate further.
